[8] 15 ICONIC PAIRWISE CONTRASTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  >> CTR-01 | Riemann Hypothesis vs. P vs. NP (NT-001 vs CS-001)
     Contrast: RH just saw dramatic Nov 20, 2026 Lean & human proof claims under fidelity audit; P vs. NP remains walled behind Relativization, Natural Proofs & Algebrization meta-barriers.
     Asymmetr: RH settles prime error bounds; P=NP with a practical algorithm would collapse global cryptography & automate math overnight.

  >> CTR-02 | Quantum Gravity vs. Hard Problem of Consciousness (GR-001 vs NEURO-001)
     Contrast: QG has crisp incompatible equations (GR vs. QFT) blocked by 10^19 GeV scale; Consciousness lacks even an agreed mathematical criterion for phenomenal experience.
     Asymmetr: QG explains Big Bang & black hole cores; Consciousness governs AI sentience rights, bioethics & meaning.

  >> CTR-03 | 3D Navier–Stokes Smoothness vs. Fluid Turbulence Closure (ANL-001 vs FLD-001)
     Contrast: Navier-Stokes Smoothness is a worst-case mathematical blowup question (subject of contested Sept 8, 2026 OpenAI claim); Turbulence Closure is an average-case multiscale statistical crisis across wings, storms & plasmas.
     Asymmetr: Proving a freak blowup leaves aerodynamics unchanged; cracking turbulence closure revolutionizes aviation, fusion & climate.

  >> CTR-04 | High-Tc Superconductivity vs. Commercial Nuclear Fusion (CM-001 vs ENR-001)
     Contrast: Fusion physics is proven possible (stars exist; NIF Q>2) making it an engineering/materials race; ambient room-T superconductivity remains an open chemical existence gamble.
     Asymmetr: Room-T superconductors would shrink fusion magnets & eliminate global grid losses simultaneously.

  >> CTR-05 | Dark Matter vs. Dark Energy (10^120 Paradox) (ASTRO-001 vs ASTRO-002)
     Contrast: Dark Matter clumps like cold particles with direct lab targets (WIMPs, axions); Dark Energy stretches vacuum uniformly with DESI 2024–2026 hints of evolving w(z)!
     Asymmetr: DM completes the matter ledger; DE decides the universe's ultimate fate & vacuum physics.

  >> CTR-06 | Abiogenesis (Origin of Life) vs. Continual AGI (BIO-001 vs AI-002)
     Contrast: Abiogenesis is a forensic 4.2-billion-year-old historical reconstruction without fossils; AGI is a forward $100B+/yr engineering race.
     Asymmetr: Abiogenesis governs cosmic habitability; AGI transforms labor, science & civilizational safety within decades.

  >> CTR-07 | Yang–Mills Mass Gap vs. Many-Body Quantum Chemistry (QM-002 vs CHEM-001)
     Contrast: Yang-Mills seeks an axiomatic 4D continuum existence proof in R^4; Quantum Chemistry seeks <=1 kcal/mol polynomial algorithms for complex molecules like FeMoco.
     Asymmetr: Yang-Mills secures Standard Model bedrock; Quantum Chemistry unlocks ambient fertilizer, batteries & drugs.

  >> CTR-08 | Continuum Hypothesis vs. Busy Beaver BB(6) (LOG-001 vs LOG-002)
     Contrast: CH concerns transfinite sets already proved independent of ZFC (Ultimate-L vs. Multiverse); BB(6) is a concrete finite integer tied to Collatz-like Antihydra.
     Asymmetr: CH shapes mathematical ontology; BB(6) maps exact small-machine limits of formal provability.

  >> CTR-09 | Earthquake Prediction vs. Planetary Climate Tipping Points (GEO-001 vs GEO-003)
     Contrast: Quakes erupt in seconds via chaotic crustal stick-slip; Climate tipping (AMOC, ice sheets) unfolds over decades with irreversible hysteresis.
     Asymmetr: Quake prediction saves cities hours ahead; tipping thresholds govern multi-trillion-dollar global climate survival.

  >> CTR-10 | Post-Moore Silicon CMOS vs. Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing (HW-001 vs QC-001)
     Contrast: Post-Moore CMOS fights quantum tunneling as an ENEMY; Quantum Computing harnesses entanglement as its ENGINE while fighting decoherence.
     Asymmetr: Post-Moore powers 99.9% of AI & daily compute; FTQC unlocks exponential chemistry, materials & cryptanalysis niches.

  >> CTR-11 | Whole-Cell Digital Twin vs. Whole-Brain Emulation (BIO-005 vs AI-004)
     Contrast: Whole-Cell models ~20k genes inside 1 micron-scale cell; Whole-Brain Emulation must scan 86B neurons, 10^14 synapses, glia & neuromodulators—triggering identity ethics.
     Asymmetr: Virtual cells revolutionize drugs & cancer; WBE reshapes mortality, law & digital consciousness.

  >> CTR-12 | AI Alignment vs. Global Climate/Commons Collective Action (AI-001 vs ECON-003)
     Contrast: AI Alignment is a vertical principal-agent gap (humans aligning superhuman optimizers); Global Commons is a horizontal 200-nation Prisoner's Dilemma.
